# CI pipeline (generated)

Regenerate after editing [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](../.github/workflows/ci.yml):

## Triggers

- **push:** `{"branches":["main","develop"]}`
- **pull_request:** `{"branches":["main"]}`

## Job: `lint-and-test`

- **runs-on:** `ubuntu-latest`

### 1. Action: actions/checkout@v4

Uses `actions/checkout@v4`.

### 2. Setup Node.js

Uses `actions/setup-node@v4`.

| Input | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `node-version` | `20` |
| `cache` | `npm` |


### 3. Install dependencies

```text

```

### 4. Generate CI pipeline doc

```text

```

### 5. Verify generated CI doc matches repo


### 6. Generate API docs (TypeDoc)

```text

```

### 7. Verify API docs match repo

```text

```

### 8. Check formatting (Prettier)

```text

```

### 9. Run linter

```text

```


### 11. Run tests with coverage

```text

```

### 12. Expo doctor

```text

```

## Job: `eas-build`

- **runs-on:** `ubuntu-latest`
- **needs:** `lint-and-test`
- **if:** `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name == 'push'`

### 1. Action: actions/checkout@v4

Uses `actions/checkout@v4`.

### 2. Action: actions/setup-node@v4

Uses `actions/setup-node@v4`.

| Input | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `node-version` | `20` |
| `cache` | `npm` |


### 3. Setup Expo

Uses `expo/expo-github-action@v8`.

| Input | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `eas-version` | `latest` |
| `token` | `${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}` |


### 4. Install dependencies

```text
npm ci
```

### 5. Build development client

```text
eas build --platform all --profile development --non-interactive
```
